acceptance.evaluation: binary64 coefficients, Horner, worse of fused (std::fma) and separate routes
acceptance.reference: F_0 at 70 decimal digits (mpmath), 60-digit provenance in the paper

solver.retry_protocol: one level below the default first meeting count is re-solved with the tightened settings; if it meets, the count drops and the next level below is retried

notes: A count is the smallest stored count at which an exhibited admissible [m/k] fit meets on the 2001 grid and passes the denominator guard; the 4001 grid is the check.
delivered_2001/4001 are in the target's kind (relative for rel:*, absolute for abs:*).
guard is the smaller of the 2001 and 4001 denominator ratios of the selected witness.
best_below is the smallest delivered error at count-1 among guard-passing pairs; below_ratio = best_below/target.
No count is a proof of minimality; it is an existence bound under this solver.
